The kingdom of [[Pharloom]] boasts a vast array of bizarre creatures and constructs alike, most of which are [[Haunting|haunted]]. All enemies can be listed in the [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]].

==Trivia==
*Multiple voice actors for <i>Silksong</i> are known to have voiced multiple unknown minor enemies:
**Matthew Fitzgerald, voice actor of [[Kratt]], [[Old Penitent]], and multiple [[Pilgrims]].<ref>{{Cite tweet|author=Matthew Fitzgerald|user=toborprime|number=2019272549956194762|title=Sure - Old Penitent, Kratt, and a handful (something like 4-5) of the "Pilgrim" category NPCs/enemies. Also a ton of little insect and enemy noises, not sure on what/where they used those.|access-date=5 February 2026}}</ref>
**Ned Rogers, voice actor of [[Creige]].<ref>Email by [https://x.com/silksongsoon/status/2020558788827246996 Ned Rogers]: <i>"I voice the bartender in Halfway Home and a few other random enemies..."</i> ([[:File:Reference Ned Rogers.png|Archive]])</ref>
**Lauren Koopowitz, voice actor of [[Shakra]] in addition to other roles.<ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pA7Id7lff6E Interview with Lauren Koopowitz] (45:53): <i>"The only problem with [this list of characters I voiced] is that it's not everyone because they had so many [...] there are a lot of like little like NPC creatures that go around."</i></ref>
*Several large or high-health enemies have a unique effect when being killed. 
*[[Furm]]s, [[Skull Scuttler]]s, [[Crustcrawler]]s, [[Coral Furm]]s, [[Fertid]]s, [[Leaf Roller]]s, [[Cogwork Crawler]]s and [[Miremite]]s are all internally referred to as a [[mariowiki:Goomba|Goomba]], in reference to the enemy from the <i>Mario</i> franchise.
